next:wr:489.hint: 警官はその泥棒の腕をつかんだ
next:wr:489.answer: The officer caught the thief by the arm.
next:wr:489.fullSentence: The officer caught the thief by the arm.
next:wr:489.explanation: catch A by the arm『Aの腕をつかむ』。
next:wr:489.relatedInfo: grab O by the collarと同じ語順パターン。

next:wr:491.hint: 彼は友人の肩をバシッと叩いた
next:wr:491.answer: He slapped his friend on the shoulder.
next:wr:491.fullSentence: He slapped his friend on the shoulder.
next:wr:491.explanation: slap A on the shoulder『Aの肩を(バシッと)叩く』。
next:wr:491.relatedInfo: pat A on the shoulder(軽く叩く)との強さの違い。

next:wr:493.hint: 彼女は優しく彼の頬に触れた
next:wr:493.answer: She gently touched him on the cheek.
next:wr:493.fullSentence: She gently touched him on the cheek.
next:wr:493.explanation: touch A on the cheek『Aの頬に触れる』。
next:wr:493.relatedInfo: kiss A on the cheekも同じパターン。

next:wr:495.hint: 彼らはその商品を原価で売った
next:wr:495.answer: They sold the goods at cost.
next:wr:495.fullSentence: They sold the goods at cost.
next:wr:495.relatedInfo: 利益を乗せずに売ることを表す。

next:wr:497.hint: 彼は自分の命の危険を冒してその子供を救った
next:wr:497.answer: He saved the child at the risk of his own life.
next:wr:497.fullSentence: He saved the child at the risk of his own life.
next:wr:497.explanation: at the risk of A『Aの危険を冒して』。
next:wr:497.relatedInfo: at the mercy of Aと形は似るが意味が異なる。

next:wr:499.hint: 彼女は15歳のときに絵を始めた
next:wr:499.relatedInfo: at a partyのように特定の場面にも使う。

next:wr:501.hint: 彼は根っからの教師だ
next:wr:501.answer: He is a teacher at heart.
next:wr:501.fullSentence: He is a teacher at heart.
next:wr:501.explanation: a teacher at heart『根っからの教師』。
next:wr:501.relatedInfo: at heartは『本質的には、根っからの』という意味。

next:wr:503.hint: 私はこの計画が全く好きではない
next:wr:503.answer: I don't like this plan at all.
next:wr:503.fullSentence: I don't like this plan at all.
next:wr:503.relatedInfo: 否定文を強調する慣用表現。

next:wr:505.explanation: call+人+at+電話番号『(番号)に電話する』。
next:wr:505.relatedInfo: atは特定の連絡先(番号・住所)を示す。

next:wr:507.hint: 溺れる者は藁にもすがる
next:wr:507.answer: A drowning man will catch at a straw.
next:wr:507.fullSentence: A drowning man will catch at a straw.
next:wr:507.explanation: catch at a straw『藁にもすがる』。ことわざとして有名。
next:wr:507.relatedInfo: catch atは『つかもうと手を伸ばす』動作を表す。

next:wr:509.hint: 彼女はその知らせを聞いて急に泣き出した
next:wr:509.answer: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
next:wr:509.fullSentence: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
next:wr:509.explanation: burst into (tears)『急に〜し始める(泣き出す等)』。
next:wr:509.relatedInfo: burst into laughter『急に笑い出す』も同じ形。

next:wr:511.hint: 彼女は彼を説得してチームに入らせた
next:wr:511.answer: She talked him into joining the team.
next:wr:511.fullSentence: She talked him into joining the team.
next:wr:511.explanation: talk A into B『Aを説得してBさせる』。
next:wr:511.relatedInfo: talk A out of Bはその反対(説得してやめさせる)。

next:wr:513.hint: 水は凍ると氷に変わる
next:wr:513.answer: Water changes into ice when it freezes.
next:wr:513.fullSentence: Water changes into ice when it freezes.

next:wr:515.hint: 彼らは午後を浜辺で過ごした
next:wr:515.answer: They spent the afternoon on the beach.
next:wr:515.fullSentence: They spent the afternoon on the beach.
next:wr:515.relatedInfo: 平面・接している場所を表すon。

next:wr:517.hint: 成功はどれだけ頑張るか次第だ
next:wr:517.answer: Success depends on how hard you work.
next:wr:517.fullSentence: Success depends on how hard you work.
next:wr:517.explanation: depend on / rely on『〜に頼る/〜次第である』。

next:wr:519.hint: 彼女はダイエットを始めることにした
next:wr:519.answer: She decided to go on a diet.
next:wr:519.fullSentence: She decided to go on a diet.
next:wr:519.explanation: go on a diet『ダイエットを始める』。
next:wr:519.relatedInfo: be on a dietなら『ダイエット中』の状態を表す。

next:wr:521.hint: 今年、彼女の誕生日は日曜日に当たる
next:wr:521.answer: Her birthday falls on a Sunday this year.
next:wr:521.fullSentence: Her birthday falls on a Sunday this year.
next:wr:521.relatedInfo: 曜日や日付が一致することを表す。

next:wr:523.hint: 電話が突然私のところで不通になった
next:wr:523.answer: The phone suddenly went dead on me.
next:wr:523.fullSentence: The phone suddenly went dead on me.
next:wr:523.explanation: go dead on (someone)『(電話などが)不通になる』。
next:wr:523.relatedInfo: onには『(その人にとって)不都合な形で』というニュアンスがある。

next:wr:525.hint: 子供たちは一日中日なたに出ていた
next:wr:525.answer: The children were out in the sun all day.
next:wr:525.fullSentence: The children were out in the sun all day.
next:wr:525.explanation: be out in the sun『日なたに出ている』。
next:wr:525.relatedInfo: inは光や空間に包まれているイメージ。

next:wr:527.hint: 彼女は彼が真の友人だと気づいた
next:wr:527.answer: She has found a true friend in him.
next:wr:527.fullSentence: She has found a true friend in him.
next:wr:527.explanation: have found a friend in A『Aが友人だと気づいた/Aに友人を見出した』。
next:wr:527.relatedInfo: inは『〜の中に(その資質を)見出す』イメージ。

next:wr:530.hint: 彼らは放課後モールでぶらぶらしている
next:wr:530.answer: They just hang around at the mall after school.
next:wr:530.fullSentence: They just hang around at the mall after school.
next:wr:530.relatedInfo: 目的なく時間を過ごすことを表す。

next:wr:532.hint: コンサートにはおよそ100人いた(約)
next:wr:532.answer: There were about a hundred people at the concert.
next:wr:532.fullSentence: There were about a hundred people at the concert.
next:wr:532.explanation: A about B『AはおよそB』(数量的に「約」)。
next:wr:532.relatedInfo: approximatelyよりカジュアルな言い方。

next:wr:534.hint: その独裁者は国全体を支配下に置いていた
next:wr:534.answer: The dictator had the entire country under his thumb.
next:wr:534.fullSentence: The dictator had the entire country under his thumb.
next:wr:534.explanation: have somebody under one's thumb『〜を支配下に置く』。
next:wr:534.relatedInfo: 『親指の下に置く』が転じて完全な支配を表す。

next:wr:536.hint: この話題は『科学』に分類される
next:wr:536.explanation: be classified under A『Aに分類される』。
next:wr:536.relatedInfo: underは分類上の見出し・項目を表す。

next:wr:538.hint: 新しい橋はまだ工事中だ
next:wr:538.answer: The new bridge is still under construction.
next:wr:538.fullSentence: The new bridge is still under construction.
next:wr:538.relatedInfo: under discussion『検討中』も同じパターン。
